name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. Diablillos is one of the world's largest undeveloped, fully-permitted silver-gold projects, with a 2026 Definitive Feasibility Study outlining a 25-year mine life. The company has completed a bridging engineering contract with Worley and is advancing toward a construction decision.
